description: Free. Browse the open vehicle catalog (1,608 makes, 42,347 models, 1990-2027) by make and/or model with typo tolerance. Returns canonical make/model names, the years each model exists and match kind; a model hit carries a stable vehicle id per year (ids, and id when the query names one year) to pass as `vehicle` to the image and 3D tools. Use it to list a make's models, to see which years exist or to let the human choose between similar models; when you already know which car is wanted, resolve_vehicle is the one call that names it.

query.description: Free text: make and/or model, optional year, typos tolerated, e.g. "porshe 911" or "2019 f150". Fewer words find more: every word must be in the name of one catalog vehicle.

year.description: Restrict results to one model year.

name: search_vehicles
title: Search the vehicle catalog
